permissions.usageDescription: 织机 uses the microphone only for recordings you start.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep import, history, and system-audio-independent features available; show a System Settings recovery action without reprompting in a loop.

permissions.usageDescription: 织机 records audio only from the app or Mac output you choose for a recording.
permissions.runtimeAuthorizationAPI: Core Audio Process Tap authorization at tap creation
permissions.deniedBehavior: Create no tap or aggregate device, retain prior recordings, and show a System Settings recovery action without widening the selected source.
Do not inspect or write another app; preserve the transcript and offer manual copy plus a System Settings recovery action.

permissions.usageDescription: 织机 reads only the calendars you choose in Settings, and never writes to them.
permissions.deniedBehavior: Keep the calendar entry off, read nothing, and show the System Settings path; every other entry and capture keeps working.

permissions.usageDescription: 织机 adds a reminder only when you click to add a next step to Reminders.
permissions.runtimeAuthorizationAPI: EKEventStore.requestFullAccessToReminders (at the first click of 把下一步加到提醒事项)
permissions.deniedBehavior: Write nothing and show the System Settings path; the matter page is unchanged.

workerPolicy.rationale: Inference receives only bounded local requests from the host and never requests TCC capture or Accessibility access.
